measurement_basis: committed-bounded-link refinement with regression and authenticated live projection verification

related_work.work_intent_goal: exercise canonical Environment persistence through the Control socket
related_work.campaign_objective: Improve how effectively MNCS language, compiler, tooling, and environment serve and potentiate agents through evidence from real development.

outcome.implementation_change: When an applied correction supplies an exact pointer already carried by its owner audit, the projection suppresses the duplicate direct link. Applied correction links are sorted ahead of other links before response-budget pruning.
outcome.implementation_scope: mncs_env.capability_relationships.project source-link de-duplication and bounded response ordering
outcome.interpretation_limit: The bounded projection now preserves the applied correction path for this source. It does not establish that an agent used the linked capability, that the pressure causes a specific host responsibility, or that migration is ready.

pressure_hypothesis.title: Applied correction provenance can be hidden by duplicate exact-pointer links under the response budget
pressure_hypothesis.subsystem: MNCS Environment capability-accountability relationship projection and bounded result serialization
pressure_hypothesis.basis: A bounded live projection after the correction was applied counted the same exact source through direct and correction-backed paths. Its response budget retained one link but truncated the correction-backed path, leaving the applied correction provenance unavailable on the returned link.
pressure_hypothesis.actionable_recommendation: When an applied correction supplies the exact pointer already present in the effective owner audit, emit one correction-backed link and prioritize applied-correction provenance before bounded link pruning.
not_measured: recurrence across other accountability projections, source types, and campaigns
whether an agent relied on the correction provenance or used the linked native capability
whether the source pressure causally blocks a host responsibility or makes migration ready
long-term effectiveness across independent sessions and environmental versions
